pages.title: Shiny car · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot Saturday in Los Angeles. Fabi’s car is covered in dust. She drives to a car wash near her home. Workers in orange shirts wave towels. Music plays and water runs down the road. A friendly man named Lou comes to her window.
“Hi there! Welcome to Sun Car Wash.” says Lou. “Hi! I would like a wash for my car, please.” says Fabi. “Sure. We have a basic wash and a full wash.” says Lou.

paragraphs: “How long does it take?” says Fabi. “About twenty minutes. You can sit in the shade.” says Lou. Fabi pays twenty dollars and leaves the keys. She sits in the shade with a cold drink. The workers wash, dry and vacuum the car. After twenty minutes, Lou waves to her. The car shines like new. A clean car makes a happy day.
